verdict.rationale: Claude Code supports event/rule-triggered automation via Hooks (shell commands triggered on file-edit/commit events), scheduled routines that also trigger 'from an API call, or in response to an event,' and MCP servers acting as channels that push messages (Telegram, Discord, webhooks) into a session to trigger reactions. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of hook or event-trigger reliability, and no detail on the range of triggerable events or conditional rule logic beyond simple examples.
